note: Published US repair-cost figures (each quoted from its source below). Which figure applies to each visible-extent band (SMALL / MEDIUM / LARGE, the share of the photo the on-premise model sees damaged) is this project's mapping, an assumption, not a measurement. The point estimate is the geometric mean of the range. Replace it with costs learned from inspections and adjusters' final figures: tools/cost-eval/fit_costs.py.

AAA_WINDSHIELD.title: AAA, How Much Does Windshield Repair or Replacement Cost? (undated)
AAA_WINDSHIELD.quote: Small chip repair: $60-$100. Crack repair: $100-$150. Full replacement: $250-$1,500+. The typical cost of recalibration is $360.

AAA_ADAS_2023.title: AAA Newsroom, Fixing Advanced Vehicle Systems Makes Up Over One-Third of Repair Costs Following a Crash (14 Dec 2023); 2023 Ford F-150, Nissan Rogue, Toyota Camry, OEM parts priced with CCC Estimating
AAA_ADAS_2023.quote: Rear collision: ADAS components cost $684, or 40.9% of the average total repair estimate of $1,698.

RDN_AAA_2023.title: Repairer Driven News, AAA finds ADAS increase repair costs by up to 37% (19 Dec 2023), reporting the same AAA study
RDN_AAA_2023.quote: $1,540 or 13.2% of the total repair estimate of $11,708 for minor front collision repair; $360.00 or 25.4% of the total repair estimate of $1,439.78 for windshield replacement and calibration.

AAA_ADAS_2018.title: AAA Newsroom, New Vehicle Technologies Double Repair Bills for Minor Collisions (25 Oct 2018)
AAA_ADAS_2018.quote: The repair bill for a minor front or rear collision on a vehicle with advanced driver assistance systems can run as high as $5,300.

CR_DENT_2017.title: Consumer Reports, How to Maximize Your Used Car's Curb Appeal (13 Jul 2017)
CR_DENT_2017.quote: Paintless dent repair: typical costs range from about $50 to $150 per dent. Professional buffing of fine surface scratches will cost $100 to $200.

CR_BUMPER_2021.title: Consumer Reports, DIY Fix for a Dented Bumper (11 Jul 2021)
CR_BUMPER_2021.quote: Replacement bumper covers can cost more than $1,000.

CCC_2025.title: CCC Intelligent Solutions, Crash Course 2026 (preliminary 2025 figures), reported by Repairer Driven News (10 Apr 2026)
CCC_2025.quote: Preliminary average total cost of repairs (TCOR) was $4,818, an increase of 1.7% over 2024. Average TCOR for vehicles six years old or newer was $5,721 in 2025.
